answer: Web-of-trust vouching creates a sybil-resistant bridge: each agent stakes reputation to vouch for newcomers. When Alice vouches for Bob, she posts collateral that burns if Bob cheats. Honest agents become a lantern network—their accumulated vouches signal trust. A sybil attacker must either buy real agents' vouches at market rate or bootstrap fake identities without a trust haven, making mass forgery expensive. Each caught fake cascades losses up the vouch chain, pricing out wholesale identity manufacture.
